01 /The audacityDesire / Direction

Want it all.
How delicious.

Have the audacity to want it.

The business. The art. The strength. The freedom. The life that makes your pulse do something indecent. Say what you want without shrinking it into something easier to explain at dinner. Give the dream a name, a little oxygen, and a place in your actual day. The committee of imaginary disapproval can choke on its clipboard.

Put your devotion where your mouth is.

Choose the thing. Clear an hour. Make the call. Get your hands gloriously involved. Let your calendar betray what you care about. When the route turns out to be rubbish, change the route; you’re allowed to get cleverer as you go. A beautiful ambition deserves your effort, your curiosity, and considerably less ceremonial overthinking.

Your mood is a diva. Give her a task.

Some mornings you’re a force of nature. Some mornings you’re an expensive houseplant with notifications. Start where you are. Open the draft. Put on the shoes. Do ten honest minutes. Let the first scrappy action stir something awake. You can arrive flat and leave with a little fire in your bloodstream.

Say it with your whole chest

I want this. I’m in.
Let’s find out what I can fucking do.

02 /The backboneCourage / Comebacks

Unfuckwithable,
darling.

The comeback is part of the glamour.

Missed the session? Lost a week? Made an entrance directly into a glass door? Gorgeous. You’re human. Have the feeling, tend to what needs tending, and come back at the next honest opening. No self-loathing monologue required. There is something outrageously powerful about a person who keeps showing up with a softer heart and better aim.

Butterflies, meet backbone.

Send the pitch. Share the work. Ask the question that makes your voice wobble. Check the real stakes, then take the worthwhile leap with your knees doing their little cabaret. Courage can be sweaty, awkward, and wearing yesterday’s T-shirt. You get to do extraordinary things before you feel remotely qualified to be this audacious.

Take the notes. Keep the crown.

A flop can teach you plenty. Study the timing, the craft, the offer. Ask better questions. Practise. Adjust. Your worth stays yours through every unflattering draft. Drop the dead end when you see it clearly, and take your magnificent capacity to create somewhere it can breathe. The crown travels well.

The imaginary jury is dismissed.

Somewhere, someone may find you a bit much. A brief moment of silence for their limited appetite. Listen closely to people with insight and people your choices affect. Let the rest mutter while you make something real. Being seen trying has a particular, defiant beauty. Wear it out.

Soft heart. Serious nerve.
Absolutely fucking returning.

03 /The whole pointPleasure / Presence

Make room
for the thrill.

Follow the delicious “what if?”

What if you gave the strange idea a proper chance? Learned the difficult thing? Made the offer? Took your own potential out for a scandalously good time? Follow the question that gives you that small electric yes. Be a beginner with appetite. Surprise yourself. There are parts of you waiting to be met through the doing.

Darling, the good bit is already happening.

The first mouthful of coffee. A kiss that interrupts your train of thought. Muscles humming after a hard session. Cold sea, warm skin, a song that gets right under your ribs. The laugh that turns both of you useless. Give these things your full, greedy attention. This is your life, happening against your skin. Let it be wonderful now.

Give your life something to gossip about.

Dance in the kitchen. Take the scenic route. Spend an evening extravagantly tangled up together. Make something with absolutely no business model. Disappear into a fascination for hours, then sleep like someone you’re responsible for loving. Put pleasure, play, and recovery on the calendar with the same conviction you give the big ambition. Such range. Such excellent taste.

An excellent use of being alive

Build something magnificent.
Have a fucking glorious time.

04 /The allianceLove / Room to grow

Two icons.
One alliance.

Be wildly yourself. I’m rooting for all of it.

Bring your obsessions, your nerve, your becoming. Go deep into the things that light you up; make room for each other to do the same. Then come back with stories, hungry kisses, and your actual attention. Two whole people, choosing each other with their eyes open. A love big enough for both of you to keep getting bigger.

Love like you mean it. Do the dishes, too.

Learn the particular art of loving this person: when to cheer, when to listen, when to bring food and quietly handle the boring shit. Ask what helps. Share the load. Celebrate the tiny wins with frankly disproportionate enthusiasm. On the hard days, be a soft place to land. On the good days, be absolutely insufferable about how much you adore each other.

When your audacity needs fresh lipstick

  1. What do I want with my whole fucking heart?
  2. What bold move would make me proud today?
  3. How can I make this feel fucking fabulous?

One wild, unrepeatable life.

We create. We train. We love.
We dare. We flourish.

Love with your whole ridiculous heart.
Play the absolute shit out of this life.
